description: Searchable command palette overlay (Cmd+K style) with filterable actions, descriptions, and keyboard shortcut hints. Supports two-way binding on open state. GroupByCategory adds a heading and a separator per category; SplitShortcuts renders one kbd per key. Both default off, which keeps the flat list and the single shortcut kbd.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the command palette is visible.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when IsOpen should change (two-way binding).

parameters.name: GroupByCategory
parameters.description: Groups actions by Category with a heading and a separator between groups. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: SplitShortcuts
parameters.description: Renders each '+'-separated part of a shortcut as its own kbd. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.
